question.text: Vindhya Event-Driven Fund is onboarding a new corporate investor — a holding company. Under PMLA Rules, the Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) of a COMPANY or TRUST investor should be identified based on controlling ownership interest of what threshold?

explanation.text: The Logic: PMLA Rules require that the UBO of a company or trust investor be identified on a controlling ownership interest basis at the 25% threshold. For a partnership firm or unincorporated association of individuals, the UBO threshold is 15% on an ownership/entitlement basis. The Trap: Option C (15%) swaps in the partnership threshold. Option A invents 10%. Option D (50%) is a control threshold, not UBO identification. Note: Workbook pages 430-431 state the 25%/15% UBO thresholds. KYC records must be filed with CKYCR within 10 days after commencement of the account-based relationship.
